definitions.A: terminal redeemable value of one selected underlying outcome in [0,1]
definitions.B: terminal redeemable value of a second selected underlying outcome in [0,1]

exact_payoff_identity.terminal_state_scope: all A and B values in [0,1], including ordinary 0_or_1 resolution and fractional 0.5 cancellation resolution
exact_payoff_identity.why_naive_implication_is_rejected: when both related markets cancel 50_50, YES(A_and_B) redeems for 0.25 while a single 0.5 leg redeems for 0.5; implication alone is therefore not an exact identity
exact_payoff_identity.why_the_full_identity_survives_cancellat: at A=B=0.5 the underlying side pays 1.0 and the combo side pays 0.25 + 0.75 = 1.0
